prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1356; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a side-impact motor vehicle collision that occurred at an intersection. Patient reported immediate onset of low back pain and paraspinal muscle tenderness with stiffness, rated 6 out of 10 at initial evaluation. No loss of consciousness or head injury was reported. Neurological examination was within normal limits, with no focal deficits in strength, sensation, or reflexes in the lower extremities. Range of motion of the lumbar spine was reduced in flexion and lateral rotation, with palpable muscle spasm over the lumbar paraspinals.

Diagnosis: Acute strain of the lumbar back musculature secondary to motor vehicle collision.

Treatment over four visits included soft tissue manual therapy, instruction in a home stretching and core stabilization program, and prescribed anti-inflammatory medication. Pain and range of motion improved steadily across visits. At the final visit, pain was rated 2 out of 10, lumbar mobility was near baseline, and the patient reported return to most daily activities.

Prognosis is good. The patient was advised to continue the home exercise program, avoid heavy lifting for two weeks, and return if symptoms worsen or radiating symptoms develop.
